gold_row.question: What light value did sensor 2.0 measure on 2004-02-28 at 01:25:16?
gold_row.gold_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 2})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
WHERE m.time STARTS WITH "2004-02-28T01:25:16"
RETURN m.time AS time, m.light AS value
ORDER BY m.time ASC
LIMIT 1
